behavior: pr-checks is a composite of bash steps with no GitHub-only action, installs dotf at a pinned version through hygiene, and runs each check behind an input.
With one check failing, every other check still runs, the summary shows each result, and the job fails.
The spec and knowledge gates read the pull request from the event file and make no API call.
dotfiles and kubelab each run one job per pull request event for the cheap checks, with branch protection updated.
